location: The junction leading to the cellar levels
physicalConditions: Maren is carrying a broken cart axle across her shoulders, sustaining pain and strain on her injured leg/shoulder.
The corridor beyond the junction is dark and damp.
A hairline fracture in the masonry has been cleared to allow passage without triggering a trap.
knowledgeEstablished: Elara identified a secondary mechanical trap involving a hidden latch, pulley system, and weight-sensitive trigger beneath the floor slab at the junction.
The trap was bypassed by slipping through a hairline fracture in the wall rather than breaking stone or using magic.
The mechanism is sensitive to uneven weight distribution, vibrations, and sound.
No magical residue was found on the trap mechanism; it relies on raw engineering.
decisionsMade: Elias instructed Elara to finish scanning the threshold before committing to entry.
Elara confirmed the presence of a secondary ceiling mechanism triggered by weight shift over the fracture.
Maren directed the group to use the solid stone wall on the left instead of walking over the fracture.
Torin agreed to lead the party through the narrow passage first.
relationshipChanges: Torin expressed approval of the successful bypass.
Maren asserted her competence and ability to manage her injury without slowing the group.
completedActions: Elias held up a lantern shield to steady the beam on the jagged edge of the cleared fracture.
Elara knelt beside the gap, brushed loose chalk from the stone floor, and identified the secondary mechanism using brass wire.
Maren shifted the broken cart axle deeper into her shoulder straps despite flaring pain.
Torin moved forward to test the balance of the axle against his stride.
Elias stepped aside to let Torin pass through the narrow passage first.
Maren followed Torin, adjusting her grip on a hammer as she moved deliberately.
unresolvedImmediateAction: The party has just begun moving through the narrow passage under the fracture, with Torin leading and Maren following closely behind while managing her pain and the axle.
